tiers.name: Student
tiers.lede: Designed for students enrolled in accredited academic or arts institutions, our Student Membership provides access to Open Studios, discounted film processing, and all the benefits of our Individual tier at a student-friendly rate.

tiers.name: Educator
tiers.lede: For individuals employed by an accredited academic or arts institution—enjoy all of the same benefits as our Individual tier at a discounted rate.

tiers.name: Individual
tiers.lede: Join a growing community of artists and creatives. With Individual Membership, enjoy a wide range of benefits, including discounts on workshops, access to exclusive member events & open calls, and much more.

tiers.name: Dual
tiers.lede: Save on membership by signing up with a friend! Our Dual Membership unlocks access to the same benefits as our Individual tier, but for two.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.lede: Take your support to the next level with Professional Membership. Receive premium perks, including 20% off workshops, a complimentary tintype session, and more.

tiers.name: Pro-Studio
tiers.button: Sign up here | PRO STUDIO MEMBERSHIP $550
tiers.lede: Pro Studio membership offers exclusive discounts on renting our northlight Highlight Studio—ideal for commercial and studio photographers.

tiers.name: Patron
tiers.lede: Support our programming at the highest level with Patron Membership.
